title: Orbit
text: Put a Water Microcore in the shape slot. Creates four spell projectiles around the selected center. Self and creature centers can move; block and air centers stay fixed.
Effects trigger on projectile contact with creatures or blocks. Selecting a creature only makes it the orbit center, without immediately applying effects to it. Orbiting projectiles can be reflected.
A Wide Area Rune increases the count to six and enlarges the orbit. Ground-Orbit follows the path formed by selected surface positions.
